seed_note: Original example-generation session used NumPy seed 190913 across all figures; the seed alone does not reconstruct digitized/manual values. The committed CSVs and SHA-256 hashes define this snapshot.

zh: Control/SA 条件下，各基因型的独立样本编号和 PR1a 表达测量。
表达归一化公式与参考基因；若使用 qPCR，保留目标/参考 Ct 和校准样本。
原始误差类型、统计检验，以及新数据应采用的断轴上下范围。
en: Independent sample IDs and PR1a expression measurements for each genotype under Control/SA.
Expression normalization and reference gene; for qPCR, preserve target/reference Ct and calibrator samples.
Original error definition, statistical test and appropriate lower/upper broken-axis ranges.

preprocessing.zh: 先按原实验方法归一化表达，再填长表；修改 value 时默认重算均值和 SEM。检查上下 y 轴范围是否覆盖新数值。
preprocessing.en: Normalize expression upstream and fill the long table. Changing value triggers mean/SEM recalculation by default. Check both y-axis ranges for new values.
